levels.description: Hoshiguma the Breacher launches her shield while hitting all blocked enemies 3 times per attack, each hit dealing <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</> of ATK; the shield flies <@ba.vup>one loop</> around this unit; the shield <$ba.sluggish>Slows</> enemies on contact, dealing <@ba.vup>{shield_atk_scale:0%}</> of ATK as Arts damage every {interval}s, while Hoshiguma the Breacher recovers HP equal to <@ba.vup>{heal_ratio:0%}</> of the damage dealt by the shield
